job.job_title: Front end developer / Full stack Developer
job.job_description:
Roles and Responsibility
Develop high-quality, responsive, and scalable web applications using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and related technologies.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and prioritize project requirements.
Design and implement user interfaces that are intuitive and visually appealing.
Ensure code quality by writing clean, modular, and well-documented code.
Participate in code reviews and contribute to the improvement of the overall codebase.
Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues efficiently.
Job Requirements
Proficiency in front-end development frameworks such as React or Angular.
Strong understanding of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and related technologies.
Experience with back-end development using languages like PHP or Python.
Familiarity with database management systems such as MySQL or MongoDB.
Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and communicate effectively with stakeholders.
